kultivator.alchemy.help.1: Alchemy Furnace: put any cauldron (empty, water, lava or powder snow) on a lit campfire or soul campfire. The furnace is only looked at: no block is ever changed.
kultivator.alchemy.help.2: Right-click the cauldron with an ingredient to put one into the pot (max 8 items). Right-click with both hands empty to look into the pot.
kultivator.alchemy.help.3: Sneak + right-click with an empty hand to refine (10 s). Only the exact ingredients of a recipe make pills, which pop out beside the cauldron; anything else turns into black smoke.
kultivator.alchemy.help.4: Success chance: 60%% + 4%% per alchemy level, +10%% on a soul campfire, +10%% for the Fire Dao (max 95%%). Failures still teach a little.
kultivator.alchemy.help.5: Quality: Low ×0.8, Mid ×1.0, High ×1.25, Perfect ×1.6 of the effect. Higher alchemy levels and soul fire give better pills, and better pills carry less toxin.
kultivator.alchemy.help.6: Put out the fire or break the cauldron to get the ingredients back. /kultivasi alchemy recipes lists every recipe, and /kultivasi alchemy level shows your mastery.
